polities.name: Croton
polities.summary: Achaean colony on the Ionian coast of Bruttium, home of Pythagoras' school and the wrestler Milo; destroyed Sybaris in 510, led the early Italiote League, fell to Dionysius I (379), Agathocles (295) and the Bruttii, and passed into Roman alliance in 277.

polities.name: Locri Epizephyrii
polities.summary: Locrian colony in southern Bruttium with the earliest written Greek law code (Zaleucus) and a famous sanctuary of Persephone; ally of Syracuse, base of Dionysius II's tyranny, garrisoned by Rome in 282, plundered by Pyrrhus (276) and by Pleminius (205).

polities.name: Acragas
polities.summary: Rhodian-Geloan colony on Sicily's south coast (Agrigento), under the tyrants Phalaris and Theron, sacked by Carthage in 406, refounded by Timoleon, ruled by Phintias in the 280s, and a Punic base in the First Punic War; taken by Rome in 262 and finally in 210.

polities.name: Vestini
polities.summary: Sabellian people of the Gran Sasso and Aterno valley (Abruzzo), around Peltuinum and Aveia; at war with Rome in 325, allied from 302, and among the insurgents of the Social War.
